detail: tools/hbox_native.sh:431 sets SOURCE_ID='$(cat build/REUSED_SOURCE)' for --reuse-image, text meant for the box script (evaluated there at :710 after link-run writes REUSED_SOURCE). :899 writes the same literal into the local record build/hbox-native/LABEL.run as source=, so tools/train.py cmd_image (source != HEAD) refuses the run though its images may be HEAD's. The record must name the images' identity source as the reused run's log states it (its == source line), resolved at launch; a reused run whose source is not HEAD is then refused by train.py correctly.
title: hbox_native.sh --reuse-image writes its record's source= as the unevaluated text $(cat build/REUSED_SOURCE), so train.py image refuses every reused run
